summary: Production recovery is explicitly documented and tested. README: Neon-native PITR is the sole database recovery strategy with 7-day restore window requirement. Monthly recovery drills: restore to isolated branch, run schema/count invariants, record RPO/RTO. Before every production migration: create and record a recovery point. Migration safety: forward-only in production, additive expand/contract, corrective migrations for defects, Neon PITR for destructive changes. Deploy checklist (DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) documents release gates. Workflows directory contains neon-pitr-restore-drill.md, apply-migrations.md. Vercel platform provides serverless function resilience.
assertions: Neon PITR as sole recovery strategy with 7-day restore window target
Monthly recovery drills with schema/count invariants and RPO/RTO recording
Migrations: forward-only, expand/contract, corrective for defects
Deployment checklist with explicit release gates
